speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, have you had any recent travel to endemic areas or close contact with someone who has a chronic infectious disease?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The symptoms of fever, night sweats, and weight loss alongside enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes are highly concerning for an infection. Have you recently traveled to or lived in an area where tuberculosis is common, or do you have any known exposure to someone with a chronic cough?

REQUEST TEST: Tuberculosis_Skin_Test (PPD)
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: TUBERCULOSIS SKIN TEST (PPD): NEGATIVE; CHEST X-RAY: CLEAR

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the test results; the negative PPD and clear chest X-ray make tuberculosis less likely despite your classic "B symptoms." Given the persistent fatigue, severe weight loss, night sweats, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, have you noticed any pain or swelling in your abdomen or neck, and have you experienced any changes in bowel habits?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CTA
REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal_CTA: Splenomegaly detected, without rebound tenderness; Lymph_Node_Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20

speaker: Doctor
text:
The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with splenomegaly and "B symptoms," strongly suggest a B-cell lymphoma. Do you have a history of autoimmune disorders or exposure to any new chemicals?

REQUEST IMAGES: PET_Scan

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The finding of a fixed, painless, and rapidly enlarging supraclavicular lymph node, combined with CD20-positive B-cell lymphoma and splenomegaly, is highly specific. Do you have any history of unexplained bruising, bleeding gums, or recurrent infections?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
